function: Learned point-cloud density enhancement (AGGRNN, MVSFNet) of the fused ISAC sensing reconstruction; sensing post-processing, not one of the seven areas (p. 8-10).
notes: Excluded under function. The radar chain (2D-FFT, OSCA-CFAR, MUSIC, p. 5-6) and the uplink-downlink data-level fusion (sphere-packing radius, p. 7-8) are classical. The learned parts are only the point-cloud completion networks AGGRNN and MVSFNet (p. 8-10), supervised on a simulated point-cloud dataset in ShapeNet format (p. 10-11): 'The Loss function for our supervised model training is GriddingLoss' (p. 8). No beam, waveform, or resource is learned, so area 5 does not fit and no area applies. Borderline: above_phy is an alternative reading, since the learning acts on the fused point cloud, not on a link function. PDF title: Deep Learning Based Multi-Node ISAC 4D Environmental Reconstruction with Uplink-Downlink Cooperation, arXiv preprint 2404.14862v1 (p. 1); the DOI is not printed, so the match rests on the file name.
